steps: Place hands in center of chest
Make a fist and place it above the navel
Apply direct pressure with a clean cloth
Elevate the wound above heart level if possible
Cool the burn with cool running water for 10-20 minutes
Cover with a loose, sterile gauze bandage
Do not apply ice, butter, or ointments to severe burns

protocols: Identify all possible exit routes from your home and neighborhood
Pack a Go-Bag (3 days of supplies)
Turn off utilities (gas, water, electricity) if instructed
Follow designated evacuation signs and official directives
go_bag_essentials: Water (1 gallon per person per day)
